Board current rating is NOT stated: per-arm worst-case stall is ~23.4 A (3 x 4.2 A + 4 x 2.7 A), so feed servo power from a separate 12 V distribution and use the adapter for data (or verify its power path). Feetech FE-URT-1 not priced (one source per item).
